---
format: caltech-memo-pdf
# Memo fields live under `memo:` because `to` and `from` are reserved
# Pandoc options at the top level of Quarto front matter.
memo:
  to: "HSS Faculty"
  # `to` and `from` accept a single string or a YAML list (one line
  # each), e.g. for committee memos:
  #   from:
  #     - "Jonathan N. Katz (chair)"
  #     - "Second Member"
  from: "Jonathan N. Katz"
  subject: "Subject of the memo"
  # The contact stack in the right column is shown only if provided:
  email: "jkatz@caltech.edu"
  mail-code: "228-77"
  phone: "x4191"
# `date` stays top-level: Quarto resolves `today` and applies the
# "MMMM D, YYYY" format only to the standard date key.
date: today
# Switch engines by changing the format to caltech-memo-typst.
---

Write the body of the memo here. Paragraphs are separated by a blank
line, exactly as in any Markdown document. The Caltech lockup and the
TO / FROM / DATE / SUBJECT block are generated for you from the front
matter above.

## Optional Section

Memos may use section headings; they render as modest bold headings
in both engines.
